gate: QRSL Origin / Canonical Refinement Selector Gate

Genesis_Pin_provenance.type: legitimacy/provenance structure on supplied retained histories plus coarse root/source/support/order data
Genesis_Pin_provenance.reason: The certified provenance stack is an extractor/certificate once fine identities/history exist; FPRL/native fine-edge birth is not derived. Pre-selection coarse Genesis data are identical for the tau family.

recoverability_order.type: ordering/admissibility structure on supplied retained events/states
recoverability_order.reason: No certified order functional ranks alternative hidden fine completions. The two tau lifts share the same coarse recoverability/order input. Choosing maximal entropy, minimum hidden information, or minimum CMI would add a new objective and would be target-sensitive.

W1_W2_W3_incidence_filling.reason: Certificates can accept/reject a supplied fine realization but contain no preference order or canonical section. Fine witness differences cannot select the fine state before that state exists.

global_positivity_support.reason: Both tau0 and taueps are faithful, positive, full support, and exact refinements of the same coarse state.

coarse_quotient_naturality.reason: Restriction is natural; its inverse requires a section on a nontrivial fiber. Existing quotient semantics do not choose that section.

factorization_theorem.statement: Let D_coarse be all currently frozen data available before a fine completion is selected. For the v13.22 admissible tau family, D_coarse is identical while the fine states are distinct. Any selector derived solely as a function of D_coarse therefore has no input distinction from which to select one hidden completion. Any candidate that uses tau-dependent fine provenance, CMI, or incidence first requires the fine realization and is circular as an origin law.
factorization_theorem.scope: Irreducibility relative to the current frozen ontology/data types; not a theorem that no future axiom or deeper ontology can select refinement.

independent_archive_support.v11_13: global admissibility is feasibility, not a refinement section; W1/W2/W3 certify rather than select.
independent_archive_support.v12_75: fine provenance ledger is a supplied-fine-world extractor; FPRL missing.
independent_archive_support.v12_76: fine-to-coarse quotient natural, reverse coarse-to-fine section noncanonical.
independent_archive_support.v12_95: existing incidence-preserving operations cannot generate new connected refinement incidence; R2RG irreducible.
independent_archive_support.v9_87: even broad covariance does not guarantee a pure-completion selector from edge data alone.

QRSL.name: Quantum Refinement Selection Law
QRSL.required_new_content: one explicit target-independent primitive or derivation that selects hidden fine quantum completion before RATS/continuum scoring; it must not be entropy/CMI/GR success chosen post hoc

next_gate.name: Post-QRSL Branch Reassessment / Metric-Affine Continuum Evidence Gate
next_gate.question: Do not add a refinement selector merely to run RATS. Reassess which Pillar-3 claims can advance without a physical coarse-to-fine quantum section; preserve finite-scale QMAR/locality theorems, label external continuum probes honestly, and identify the highest-leverage independent bridge to ADM/GR that does not depend on QRSL.
